verdict.rationale: Cognee's `.recall()` operation is documented as a single-call retrieval that auto-routes and searches memory using the best available source, and session caching (`remember`/`session_id`) supports fast, session-scoped retrieval — covering the 'one call, relevant memories' part of the story. However, there is no documented token-budget parameter or explicit guarantee that the returned block is formatted/truncated to fit a prompt token limit. Missing for 10: explicit token-budget control on retrieval, documentation of prompt-formatted output, and independent/hands-on confirmation of context-block assembly behavior.
